mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome—I'm so glad you're here. Have you ever found yourself wanting so badly to help someone you love, that you end up shouldering their burdens, or maybe even trying to fix their problems for them? If that sounds familiar, you're definitely not alone. Together, we're about to step into the world of *I Don't Have to Make Everything All Better* by Gary B. Lundberg. This isn't just a book—it's an invitation to rethink the way we support and connect with the people who matter most. You’ll see how our natural urge to rescue, to smooth things over, and to make everything right often comes from a place of love—but sometimes, it can hold us back, and even create distance we never intended. Imagine what might change if, instead of trying to solve every problem, we simply listened—really listened—and let those we care about own their feelings. In these next moments, we'll explore how shifting from fixing to understanding can bring a whole new sense of peace and authenticity to our relationships. We'll talk about letting go of control, giving space for honest expression, and discovering the power of just being present. So, as we set out on this journey together, let's open ourselves to the possibility of more genuine connection, healthier boundaries, and a little more compassion for ourselves and those we love. Ready to see what a difference it can make? Let's get started.
